title: SafeStream
tagline: Enterprise payroll stablecoin streaming provider platform. Revolutionizes the payroll systems
description:
SafeStream - Enterprise Payroll Stablecoin Streaming Platform. The streaming payroll infrastructure for the enterprise payroll market, leveraging PYUSD's regulatory compliance to enable second-by-second salary distributions—driving mass stablecoin adoption where it matters most: everyday business operations for next-generation payroll systems."

THE PROBLEM
    Traditional payroll operates on outdated batch processing - employees work continuously but get paid monthly, creating cash flow problems for workers and slow, expensive cross-border payments. Worse, enterprises exploring stablecoin payroll face prohibitive gas costs: paying 100 employees monthly requires 100 on-chain transactions every cycle, costing thousands in gas fees and making blockchain payroll financially impractical.

THE SOLUTION
    SafeStream enables continuous per-second PYUSD salary streams using Superfluid Protocol. Instead of monthly batch payments, employees watch their balance grow in real-time as they work. Companies deposit PYUSD once, wrap it into PYUSDx (Super Token), and create streams that flow automatically - paying 100 employees requires just 100 setup transactions, then zero gas costs for continuous payments.

HOW IT WORKS
    Companies set annual salaries (e.g., $60,000/year = 1.9 wei/second), and SafeStream handles the rest. Streams flow continuously from company wallets to employees, who can withdraw earned balances anytime. The dashboard provides real-time visibility into active streams, burn rates, and runway projections.

DUAL WORKSPACE MODES
   Single Wallet Mode: Direct control for startups - one wallet manages all payroll with immediate execution.
    Safe Multisig Mode: Enterprise governance requiring multiple signature approvals (2-of-3, 3-of-5) for security and compliance.

KEY BENEFITS
- Workspace managing payroll system.
- 92% reduction in transactions (100 setup vs 1,200 monthly payments/year)
- Real-time earnings access for employees
- Transparent, borderless PYUSD payments backed by PayPal
- Enterprise-grade security with Safe multisig
how_its_made:
HOW IT'S MADE - SafeStream Technical Deep Dive

TECHNOLOGIES & INTEGRATION
1. SUPERFLUID PROTOCOL - The Core Streaming Engine
Key Integration Points:
- ISuperToken interface for PYUSDx (wrapped PYUSD) operations
- CFAv1 (Constant Flow Agreement) for stream creation/updates/deletion
- ISuperfluid Host contract for protocol-level operations
- Flow rate calculations: Annual salary → wei per second conversion
```
Annual Salary: $60,000
Flow Rate Calculation: (60000 * 10^18) / (365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60) = 1,902,587,519 wei/second
```
We built custom React hooks that wrap Superfluid operations with Wagmi's contract interaction patterns. This provides a clean, React-friendly API for stream management.

2. SAFE PROTOCOL - Enterprise Multisig Governance
3. PAYPAL USD (PYUSD) - The Stablecoin Foundation
Technical Integration:
- PYUSD wrapping into PYUSDx (Super Token) via SuperTokenFactory
- 1:1 mint/burn ratio maintained by Superfluid protocol
- Balance tracking for both PYUSD and PYUSDx across all supported chains
- Token approval flows optimized with Wagmi's useWriteContract hooks
